title: Hatfield’s Hideout Riverfront Cabins and Campground

services.name: RV Sites
services.desc: We offer DIRECT ACCESS to over 300 Miles of the Hatfield McCoy Trail System. We are strategically located across from the Devil Anse Trail and Trailhead, which is the connecting trail system for Rock House and Buffalo Mountain. This gives you the ability to easily explore all three of these nationally recognized trails. We are also strategically located between the Kentucky and West Virginia Outlaw Trail Systems, with hundreds of miles to explore there as well. You are minutes away from gas, groceries, and restaurants in McCarr, KY, and Matewan, WV, all of which you can drive your SxS to. services.name: Hatfield McCOY Tent Sites
services.desc: Step back in time to the early 1900s and experience a night in our covered wagon, just like the pioneers who crossed the plains-only with modern comforts! Enjoy a unique and cozy stay with full access to all the amenities at the campground, blending history with convenience for an unforgettable adventure. Hatfield's Hideout RV Rentals offer a comfortable and fully equipped stay with access to all the campground amenities. Each rental features 50-amp electricity, a mini fridge, and an oven. Enjoy the convenience of a public shower and bathroom, along with a shaded, waterfront site that includes a charcoal grill, fire ring, picnic table, and dense gravel pad.
